Two Russian cruise missiles and a drone crashed in south-eastern Poland on 20 November during a mass attack on Ukraine; Prime Minister Tusk called it an intentional provocation, and NATO scrambled jets.
Bahrain said an Iranian attack set fire to a civilian industrial site on 21 November, with no injuries; UKMTO logged three tanker-attack reports near Khasab on 20-21 November.
Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin issued a joint declaration in Shenzhen on 19 November that nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought; it did not mention Ukraine or Iran.
Denmark said Russian intelligence initiated a foiled plot to kill a US-Ukrainian rapper near Copenhagen and expelled Russia's defence attaché.
A drone strike set the Russian military-linked cargo ship Sparta II ablaze in the Gulf of Finland on 21 November; Finland said Ukraine was likely behind it.
Estonia will close all its road crossings with Russia from 1 December for at least six months, its government decided on 20 November.
A Houthi attack damaged the Public Investment Fund tower in Riyadh's financial district on 19 November; Saudi civil defence said no one was hurt.
Iraqi forces deployed into Kataib Hezbollah's Jurf al-Sakhar stronghold on 20 November under a deal for the group to withdraw within a month.
